customer.title: Customers
customer.createNotice: A unique temporary password will be generated and shown once after account creation. Customers receive no admin roles.
customer.deliveryNotice: Verify the recipient first, then deliver in person or through a verified one-to-one channel. The temporary password cannot be recovered after closing this dialog.
customer.recipientPlaceholder: Enter the recipient for the audit record
customer.usernameNicknameRequired: Enter both a username and nickname
customer.confirmClearContent: The temporary password will not be retained or available to view again after closing.
customer.resetPasswordNotice: The current password will stop working. The customer must change the new temporary password at next sign-in.
customer.freezeNotice: Freezing immediately revokes every device authorization for this customer.
customer.unfreezeNotice: Unfreezing does not restore old authorizations. The customer must sign in again.
